observed_counts.carriers_resolved counts a deduplicated duplicate carrier as resolved (the DUPLICATE_CARRIER diagnostic discloses the dedup)

root_integration_steps: 1. In the existing single HTML walk, observe carriers during the same traversal (kind/unit_ids/value_refs/parent_id/attributes with only native concept/visibility/speaker/turn_id/turn_role); no second parse and no document-family decision in normalization.

2. Carry the observed carriers through the surviving native structure (parent/turn association) and the existing adapter into du4-source-signal-observation/1; declared source metadata stays a separate input.

3. Call collect_source_signals with the existing route WorkBudget instance (no second budget); reserve reserved_unit_ids first inside the unchanged 200-unit/64000-char probe cap, then fill with the existing deterministic spread.

4. Consume source_form_evidence/turn_evidence as scoped facts inside the single existing router/arbitration; the form reason must cite the actual carrier_unit_ids; conflicts remain diagnostics; parent/attachment scope must survive child_ranges arbitration.
5. Strip any transient reading-only carrier metadata before durable spans/ID/wire (follow the existing to_evidence_span transient-layout pattern); keep old durable span IDs and wire stable.
6. ROOT runs the real E2E, the VRSK replay and the transcript/8-K holdouts; missing real specimens stay NOT_EVALUATED rather than synthetic-green.
